notes: DEMATEL scores are a single-respondent draft (Camille). Each team member should fill the same 8 x 8 table (0 = no direct influence, 1 = low, 2 = medium, 3 = high, 4 = very high); add them as further respondents.

rationale.climate_risk -> water: Drought and heat raise water stress
rationale.climate_risk -> cooling_climate: More extreme heat raises peak cooling load
rationale.climate_risk -> energy_carbon: Extreme weather stresses grid reliability and prices
rationale.climate_risk -> land_ecology: Flood-prone land and wetlands constrain developable land
rationale.climate_risk -> transportation: Floods and storms disrupt road and rail access
rationale.cooling_climate -> energy_carbon: Higher cooling load raises PUE, electricity use and emissions
rationale.cooling_climate -> water: Evaporative cooling consumes more water in hot climates
rationale.energy_carbon -> water: Thermoelectric generation withdraws and consumes water
rationale.energy_carbon -> climate_risk: Emissions contribute to long-run climate change (weak at regional scale)
rationale.water -> energy_carbon: Water scarcity can curtail thermoelectric plants
rationale.land_ecology -> climate_risk: Wetlands and low impervious cover buffer flooding
rationale.land_ecology -> water: Land cover affects watershed recharge and runoff
rationale.fiber -> workforce_community: Connectivity attracts technical employers and workers
rationale.workforce_community -> fiber: Population and businesses justify fiber build-out
rationale.workforce_community -> transportation: Population centres receive road and rail investment
rationale.transportation -> workforce_community: Highway access widens the commuting labour shed
rationale.transportation -> fiber: Long-haul fiber is laid along highway and rail rights-of-way
rationale.transportation -> land_ecology: Transport corridors drive development of open land

interaction_model.kappa_meaning: Interaction intensity as a share of the largest scale that keeps the Choquet score monotone for the customer's weights
interaction_model.beta_meaning: Share of the DEMATEL link in the strength of a redundancy; the rest is the positive Spearman correlation

pairs.rationale: Compounding risk: drought and heat events amplify water stress (DEMATEL climate -> water is the strongest link)
Compounding risk: a hot climate raises cooling water demand exactly where water may be scarce
Compounding: a hot climate raises PUE, so a carbon-intensive grid hurts more (cross-state only)
Compounding: extreme weather stresses an already unreliable or carbon-intensive grid (cross-state only)
Both proxy access to an urban centre; positive correlation in both states
Prior: both track urbanization. Kept as a hypothesis so the data check is visible; dropped where rho <= 0
Long-haul fiber follows highway and rail rights-of-way; kept only where the data show overlap
